newsitem.title: USA: Sex offender killed after attacking Internet friend.
newsitem.headline: Sex offender killed after attacking Internet friend.

text.p: A sex offender who befriended a woman on the Internet and then tried to sexually assault her was beaten to death by the woman's son, police said on Tuesday.
William Miller, 42, was battered with a baseball bat late on Sunday after he attacked Kathy Brock at her home in Rio Rancho, about 10 miles (15 km) north of Albuquerque, police said.
"Miller was let in the house and it all went downhill from there," said John Francis, a spokesman for the Rio Rancho Department of Public Safety.
He said Miller, an Arizona native and a registered sex offender, met Brock on an Internet chat page and the two struck up a friendship.

Miller arrived at the house on Sunday and tied up Brock's 21-year-old son Chris and his friend after they let him in. When Kathy Brock arrived home, Miller threatened her with a gun and tried to sexually assault her.
The son used a cigarette lighter to burn through the ropes binding him and beat Miller with a baseball bat. Miller died on Monday at an Albuquerque hospital.
Francis said a preliminary police investigation showed Brock acted in self-defence when he beat Miller and would probably not face charges for the killing.
